name: FishWatch
tagline: US seafood species profiles and sustainability data from NOAA
description: FishWatch provides free, public US seafood species profiles including sustainability, biology, nutrition, harvest methods, and fishery status. Built for fisheries apps, seafood education, and sustainability tools.

auth.details: No authentication required; public unauthenticated REST endpoints.

use_cases: list all US seafood species profiles
get sustainability data for a fish species
look up harvest methods and fishery status
fetch nutrition facts for seafood species
